text:
sam: Can we make role-tailored goal & handoff templates? I get a lot of vague self-reviews from PMs and engineers. Need cut-and-pasteable lines per role.
lara: yes—let's make short bundles: eng, pm, manager, and a hiring-ops handover brief. Also add a single policy pointer about PTO/comp time for folks handing off.
toni: add a one-line line for benefits impact if someone's asking for headcount or comp changes (helps people ops triage).
evan: i'll add a hiring ops handover snippet so recruiters and managers don't lose context when roles change.
kevin: include 2 calibration-ready manager comments (short). keep everything under 140 chars per line so it fits forms.
oncall-bot: Reminder: self-review window opens Mon; bring final drafts to calibration slot on Tue.

--- TEMPLATES (paste-ready, one-per-line) ---

ENG: outcome line -> metric anchor -> blocker/next step
- Eng outcome: Built [feature] to allow [user action]; improved [metric].
- Eng metric: [metric] baseline [X] -> [Y] (delta +/-%).
- Eng next: Blocked by [component/infra]; owner: @NAME; ETA [date].

PM: concise impact + stakeholder note + launch status
- PM impact: Defined & shipped [initiative] with [team] to achieve [user/business outcome].
- PM stakeholders: Partners: [teams]; decisions: [key tradeoff].
- PM launch: Status: [alpha/beta/prod]; major risk: [brief].

MANAGER (people development): growth goal -> signal -> coaching ask
- Manager goal: Develop [direct report] in [skill/area] by assigning [stretch work].
- Signal: Observed [behavior change] in [N] 1:1s / improved [? metric].
- Ask: Request : [training budget/mentor/headcount] by [date].

HIRING-OPS HANDOFF (use when a role changes or is backfilled)
- One-line role brief: Role covers [ownership area]; immediate project: [A]; weekly sync: [link].
- Needed now: Must-know context (3 bullets): 1) Critical stakeholders, 2) Active tickets/PRs, 3) Alerts/runbook links.
- Recruiter note: Interview focus -> [skills/behaviors]; suggested hiring committee: [names].

BENEFITS / POLICY POINTER (paste when asking for exceptions)
- Policy note: For PTO/comp exceptions, see Benefits guide (link) and flag people-ops@redwood for approvals; approvals typically take 3-5 business days.
- Comp/headcount ask: Attach business case + org chart + requested timeline to speed review.

MANAGER CALIBRATION SNIPPETS (paste in notes)
- High impact: "Consistently delivered cross-team outcomes; measurable effect on [metric]."
- Needs coaching: "Reliable delivery on tasks; recommended focus on stakeholder communication."

USAGE HINTS (one-line each)
- Where to paste: Put outcome + metric in self-review, add next-step in the handoff section.
- Keep to one strong metric or one clear qualitative win; avoid long lists.

sam: This looks good. i'll pilot with eng and pm managers and collect 2 anonymized examples.
lara: i'll capture the final version in the handbook and link the review form. thanks everyone.
kevin: if you want, i can write a tiny script to populate these fields into the review template automatically.
evan: will share a sanitized hiring ops example by EOD to include in the handbook.
lara: last call for wording edits before handbook publish. :sparkles:
